theater: 雁門郡莫壁谷（今山西代縣一帶）

battle.name: 尉文通起義
battle.theater: 雁門郡莫壁谷（今山西代縣一帶）
battle.brief: 大業六年（610）六月，雁門賊帥尉文通聚眾三千，保於莫壁谷，隋廷遣鷹揚將軍楊伯泉擊破之。同年王薄在濟北聚亡命數萬，張須陀以齊郡丞之官往討，岱山、臨邑連破之。卡面埃及長矛未隨軍而至，它代表軍陣中數量最多的近身刺擊兵器，隋代由鐵矛與馬槊擔當同一角色。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 大業六年（610）六月，這場衝突發生在隋朝北部邊郡雁門（今山西代縣一帶）的山地之間。交戰的一方是隋朝官軍：由朝廷直接派遣、以鷹揚將軍楊伯泉為統率的追討部隊，兵員來自北方各州郡的郡兵與縣兵，配備與糧秣由郡治與州府所在的大城調撥。同一時間段，隋廷在北方另一條戰線上倚重的是齊郡郡丞張須陀所領的郡兵——同年濟北王薄聚結亡命數萬，張須陀以地方官身份統兵討平，戰後以功遷齊郡通守，領河南道十二郡黜陟討捕大使。值得注意的是，隋朝這時能迅速壓制的只是有明顯首領、聚眾而起的叛軍，真正可調的精銳宿衛與府兵主力，正被抽去籌備北征高句麗，所以官軍一線靠的是郡兵、是地方官、是臨時召集的鄉勇。另一方是起義者：尉文通，史書稱「雁門賊帥」，聚眾三千，保於莫壁谷。史料沒有給他任何編制、旗號或職名，只留下「賊帥」這個稱呼，說明這支人馬是以地方亡命與無籍之徒為主、靠一處山谷作依托的鬆散武裝集團。雙方的指揮系統都極簡：叛方靠首領一人與山谷的地形，官方靠一名將軍與郡兵的有限集結。
countriesEn: This clash took place in the sixth year of Daye, 610 AD, among the mountains of Yanmen commandery in the northern frontier of the Sui, in what is now the neighbourhood of Dai county in Shanxi. One side was the Sui field force: a pursuing column sent directly by the court, led by an officer of the rank of eagle-raiser general, Yang Boquan, with men drawn from the commandery and county militia of the northern prefectures, and with equipment and grain moved out of the commandery seats and the larger prefectural towns. Over the same stretch of months the court was relying on the other northern front line on the troops of Zhang Xutuo, then magistrate of Qi commandery: in the same year Wang Bo gathered tens of thousands of fugitives in the north of Jibei, and Zhang Xutuo put him down in his official capacity as a local magistrate, and was afterwards promoted to governor of Qi commandery and to inspector of the twelve commanderies of the Henan circuit. It is worth noting what the Sui could and could not do in 610: what it could crush quickly was a revolt with a visible leader and gathered men, while the elite guard and the militia households that could really be relied on were being drawn away to prepare the campaign against Goguryeo. The column that went out was therefore made of local militia, of local officials and of villagers hired on the spot. The other side was the insurgents: Wei Wentong, whom the annals call the bandit chief of Yanmen, who gathered three thousand men and entrenched himself in the valley of Mobi. The records give him no establishment, no banner and no title, only that description of a bandit chief, which says that this was a loose body of local fugitives and unregistered men relying on a single valley for its footing. The command structure on both sides was rudimentary: the rebels on the authority of one leader and the terrain of a defile, the government on one general and the limited concentration of a county militia.
people: 尉文通是這場起義唯一有名字的人，而史書對他的記錄只有《隋書·帝紀下》大業六年六月的一條：「雁門賊帥尉文通聚眾三千，保於莫壁谷。遣鷹揚楊伯泉擊破之。」他的籍貫、出身、年齡、旗下有多少編制與裝備、以及此後的去向，全部空白，連同時代的《資治通鑑》與後世諸史也沒有為他立傳。可以確定的是三件事：他是雁門本地或至少在雁門聚眾的武裝首領，號召力足以湊出三千人，他選擇的是依山守谷而不是攻擊州縣。官軍一方的統帥楊伯泉同樣只有這一筆記載，官階是鷹揚，屬隋代將軍名號中位階不高的資歷；《隋書》沒有為他立傳，此外便無從追考。真正在北方另一條戰線上被朝廷倚重的是張須陀，弘農閿鄉人，出身軍伍，性剛烈而有勇略，弱冠即從史萬歲討西爨，以功授儀同；煬帝即位後他從楊素平定北方宗室之亂，官拜齊郡丞，兼管一郡的民政與武備。他在大業初年曾先開倉賑饑再上狀事，說明他是一個願意擔責任的地方官。上位者是隋煬帝楊廣：同年他正把注意力放在遼東與江都兩條線上，對雁門這種三千人的邊郡叛亂，只派得出鷹揚一級的將領帶兵去處理；但他對能打的將領毫不吝惜，張須陀平王薄之後，他下詔褒揚，還令使者圖畫張須陀的形貌上奏，以示激勵。
peopleEn: Wei Wentong is the only one of this rising who has a name, and the record of him is a single entry in the sixth year of Daye, June, in the Annals of the Suishu: 'the bandit chief of Yanmen, Wei Wentong, gathered three thousand men and entrenched himself in the valley of Mobi. Yang Boquan of the rank of eagle-raiser general was sent and broke him.' His native place, his origin, his age, the organisation and the equipment of the men under him, and where he went afterwards are all blank, and neither the Zizhi Tongjian of the same age nor the later histories give him a biography. Three things can be certain: he was an armed leader who drew followers in Yanmen or at least gathered them there, his muster was enough to bring three thousand men together, and what he chose was to hold a mountain valley rather than to attack the prefectural towns. On the government side, the commander Yang Boquan has this one entry and no more; his rank was that of eagle-raiser, one of the middling grades of the Sui's military titles, and the Suishu gives him no biography, so nothing further about him can be traced. The man the court was really relying on, on the other northern front, was Zhang Xutuo of Helin county in Hongnong, a soldier's son, fierce in temper and resourceful in war, who was given the rank of yitong for his service with Shi Wansui against the Xianbei in his youth; after Yang Guang took the throne he served under Yang Su in putting down the revolt of the northern prince, and took office as magistrate of Qi commandery, where he was in charge of both the civil administration and the defence of the district. Early in Daye he opened his granaries to feed the hungry and reported the fact afterwards, which shows a man ready to shoulder responsibility. Above them all stood Sui Yangdi. In that same year his attention was fixed on the north-east and on Jiangdu, and for a rising of three thousand men in a frontier commandery he could only send an officer of the rank of eagle-raiser; but he was not stingy with the generals who could fight, and after Zhang Xutuo had broken Wang Bo he issued an encomium and even had an envoy take a portrait of Zhang Xutuo back with him, as an encouragement to the others.
kits: 卡面上這支埃及長矛不會出現在雁門的山谷：它是早王朝時期的埃及兵器，銅或青銅矛頭以繩纏或榫綁在木杆上，用來守城垣，也用來收復失地，是人類最早把「刺」這個動作標準化、把刺擊武器化的一次嘗試。把它放進這場戰爭的裝備表，是因為它佔據的是軍陣中數量最多、門檻最低的那一格——近身刺擊兵器。真正在莫壁谷一線對峙的，是中國的矛與槊：官軍郡兵手中的長矛，鐵或鋼矛頭安在長木杆上；叛軍三千人則更原始，多半把鋤、鐮、叉與削尖的竹木改造過來，靠人數在窄谷裡堵路。隋代兵器中與矛並列的是刀，庫藏的橫刀、陌刀用於劈砍與馬上搏鬥；弓弩負責遠程，弩機在魏晉南北朝已經成熟，是官軍在谷口外壓制人數優勢的依據；護具方面有明光甲與馬鎧，隋的騎兵正從輕騎向具裝過渡。運輸與後勤靠牛車、馬匹與輜重隊，隋軍在北方平叛慣用斷糧與斷渡河的辦法，同年張須陀討王薄就曾遣舟師斷其津濟，說明官軍很清楚義軍的生命線在糧食與渡口。攻城與守城的器物包括巢車、雲梯、撞車與穴地掘進的地道；烽燧與長城沿線則是雁門郡本身的邊防骨架。埃及那支矛在此只作為技術譜系的代表：從早王朝的銅矛，到隋代的鐵矛，中間是同一條線的延伸。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card would not have been present in a valley of Yanmen. It is an Egyptian weapon of the Old Kingdom: a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft with cord or a tenon, used to defend city walls and used to recover lost ground, and it is one of the earliest attempts to standardise the act of thrusting and to turn the thrusting arm into a weapon in its own right. It belongs in the equipment table of this war because it occupies the largest and least demanding slot in any order of battle, the close-combat thrusting arm. What actually faced each other on the line of the Mobi valley was the Chinese spear and the shao. The long spears of the government militia had iron or steel heads fixed to long wooden shafts; the three thousand men of the rebels were far more primitive, for the most part turning hoes, sickles, forks and sharpened bamboo and wood to use, relying on numbers to bar the mouth of a narrow valley. Among the arms of the Sui the sabre stood beside the spear, the hengdao and the modao in the treasuries being for cutting and for fighting on horseback; the bow and the crossbow supplied the long range, the trigger mechanism of the crossbow having been mature since the Wei, Jin and Northern and Southern dynasties, and it was on the crossbow that the government troops relied to check the numerical advantage of the crowd outside the mouth of the valley; for protection there were the bright armour of the Ming Guang type and the caparison of the horse, Sui cavalry being in transition from light horse to fully armoured horse. Transport and supply ran on ox carts, horses and baggage trains, and the Sui army in the north had a habit of cutting grain and cutting the ferries, as Zhang Xutuo did in the same year against Wang Bo when he sent a river flotilla to interrupt the crossings, which shows that the government understood perfectly well that the life of a rebel army lay in its grain and its fords. The siege and defence works included the nest-cart, the scaling ladder, the battering ram and the digging of tunnels under the walls, while the beacon towers and the line of the Great Wall were the frontier skeleton of Yanmen commandery itself. The Egyptian spear stands here only as the representative of a line of technique: from the copper spear of the Old Kingdom to the iron spear of the Sui, with the same thread running between them.
tactics: 關於莫壁谷一戰的作戰過程，現存史料幾乎一句話都沒有留下：帝紀只記「聚眾三千，保於莫壁谷」與「遣鷹揚楊伯泉擊破之」，既無兵種編制，也無進攻次序。因此這裡能寫的，是從同年北方平叛的實戰記錄反推的框架。義軍的戰法可以確定的是「保」：依山守谷，扼住谷口，把自己放在地形上做屏障，靠堵塞通道與官軍周旋，而不是主動出擊州縣；這是邊郡亡命徒最常見的起事模式，人少、地險、糧少，撐不了多久。官軍這邊，隋廷的應對一向是派一支精兵直搗據點，限期拔除，避免叛勢坐大；同年張須陀對王薄的戰法可以作為同一年份、同一戰區官軍打法的樣本：先以精銳出其不意，擊潰敵眾主力，再乘勝追擊至臨邑復破；斷其渡河之路以絕糧道，用舟師封住津濟；對屯於蹲狗山的左孝友眾十萬，列八風營步步逼近，再分兵扼住要害，迫其面縛來降；對合圍北海的秦君弘、郭方預，則簡選精兵倍道疾進，打敵人不備，一戰斬數萬級。整套辦法的核心是三件事：以精兵打烏合、以糧道與渡口困住亂眾、以連續奔襲消耗對方的持久力。莫壁谷的官軍無疑也循這條路徑，只是史書懶得記。
tacticsEn: Of the actual course of the fighting at the Mobi valley, the surviving records leave almost nothing: the annals say only that he 'gathered three thousand men and entrenched himself in the valley of Mobi' and that 'Yang Boquan of the rank of eagle-raiser was sent and broke him', with no order of battle, no strength of arm and no sequence of attack. What can be set down therefore is the framework inferred from the practical fighting of the northern suppressions in the same year. The way the insurgents fought is fixed by the word 'entrenched': holding to the mountains and defending the valley, barring the mouth of the defile, making the terrain their shield and standing up to the government troops rather than attacking the prefectural towns themselves, which was the commonest pattern of rising among the fugitives of the frontier, few in number, strong in position, short of grain and unable to hold out long. On the government side the Sui court had a settled response: send a picked force straight at the stronghold and take it within a fixed term, so that the revolt could not gather momentum, and the fighting of Zhang Xutuo against Wang Bo in the same year serves as a sample of how the government fought in that same year and in that same theatre. First, chosen troops fell on the enemy unexpectedly and broke the main body of the crowd, and then the victory was carried in pursuit as far as Linyi for a second break. Second, the line of the river was cut to strangle the enemy's supply, a river flotilla being sent to hold the fords. Third, against the ten thousand of Zuo Xiaoyou posted on the crouching-dog hill, eight wind-sign camps were deployed to press in by degrees while detachments were held on the key passes, until he came in with his hands bound and surrendered. Fourth, against Qin Junhong and Guo Fangyu, who had invested Beihai, picked troops were chosen and sent by forced march to strike where the enemy was unprepared, taking several thousand in a single action. The core of the method is three things: picked troops against a motley crowd, the strangling of the crowd by its grain route and its fords, and the wearing of the enemy down by repeated rapid blows. The government column at the Mobi valley followed that same path; the histories simply did not bother to record it.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但都出自《隋書》原文，毋須估算。第一，時點：《隋書·帝紀下》大業六年六月，「六月辛卯，室韋、赤土並遣使貢方物。壬午，雁門賊帥尉文通聚眾三千，保於莫壁谷。遣鷹揚楊伯泉擊破之。」起事與被平都在同一個月內，兩次干支只隔一日到數日之間。第二，兵眾：聚眾三千，這是《隋書》給出的唯一兵數。第三，雁門郡的底子：《隋書·地理志》記大業初代州降為雁門郡，統縣五，戶四萬二千五百二，縣為雁門、繁畤、崞、五台、靈丘；雁門縣境內有關官（雁門關）、長城、摐頭山與夏屋山，莫壁谷就在這一段邊塞山地的範圍內，與代縣（今山西代縣）一帶相當。第四，同年北方的另一場大規模叛亂可作對照：張須陀傳記王薄「聚結亡命數萬人」，須陀選精銳出其不意擊之，斬首數千級，追至臨邑再破，斬五千餘級、獲六畜萬計；其後孫宣雅等眾十餘萬攻章丘，須陀遣舟師斷其津濟、率馬步二萬襲擊大破；裴長才眾二萬奄至城下，他親率五騎迎戰；秦君弘等圍北海，斬數萬級、獲輜重三千兩；十年左孝友眾將十萬屯蹲狗山，須陀列八風營迫其降。第五，距離：雁門（代縣）至京師洛陽約五百餘公里，唐制一里約合今半公里，即約一千餘里，急行軍可日行百餘里。凡此數字中，尉文通一條只有三千人，其餘都屬同年北方平叛的旁證，不能當作莫壁谷一戰的實際傷亡。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, but all of them come from the text of the Suishu and need no estimating. First, the date: in the sixth year of Daye, in the sixth month, the Annals of the Suishu read: 'In the sixth month, on the day xin-mao, the Xianbei of Shuwei and Chitu both sent envoys with tribute. On the day ren-wu, the bandit chief of Yanmen, Wei Wentong, gathered three thousand men and entrenched himself in the valley of Mobi. Yang Boquan of the rank of eagle-raiser was sent and broke him.' The rising and its suppression both fall inside a single month, with the two cyclical days only a day or a few days apart. Second, the numbers of men: three thousand gathered, the only strength figure the Suishu gives. Third, the base of Yanmen commandery: the Geography Treatise of the Suishu records that in the early years of Daye Dai prefecture was reduced to Yanmen commandery, with five counties and forty-two thousand five hundred and two households, the counties being Yanmen, Fanzhi, Tuo, Wutai and Lingqiu; within Yanmen county were the border pass, that is the Yanmen guan, the line of the Great Wall, the Zhangtou hills and the Xiawu mountain, and the valley of Mobi lies within this belt of frontier mountain, answering to the neighbourhood of Dai, in what is now Dai county in Shanxi. Fourth, the other large rising in the north in the same year serves as a control: the biography of Zhang Xutuo records that Wang Bo 'gathered tens of thousands of fugitives', that Zhang Xutuo chose picked troops, struck unexpectedly and cut off several thousand heads, and that pressing the pursuit to Linyi he broke them again, cutting off more than five thousand and taking livestock to the number of ten thousand; later Sun Xuan Ya and the rest, more than a hundred thousand strong, attacked Zhangqiu, and Zhang Xutuo sent a river flotilla to interrupt their crossings and fell on them with twenty thousand of horse and foot; the two thousand of Pei Zhangcai came suddenly to the city wall and he met them with five horsemen; Qin Junhong and his men, who invested Beihai, were cut off to the number of several thousand, with three thousand loads of baggage taken; and in the tenth year the hundred thousand of Zuo Xiaoyou posted on the crouching-dog hill were pressed with eight wind-sign camps until he surrendered. Fifth, distances: from Yanmen, that is Dai, to the capital at Luoyang is some five hundred kilometres or more, a Tang li being about half a kilometre, so that the road runs to something over a thousand li, and a forced march can cover a little over a hundred li a day. Of all these numbers, the only one that belongs to Wei Wentong is the three thousand; the rest is collateral evidence from the northern suppressions of the same year and cannot be read as the actual losses at the Mobi valley.
cause: 要理解這場起義為什麼會在雁門冒出來，得把大業六年的整體形勢攤開。第一層是國家的狀態：隋文帝末年已用過極重的役使，隋朝以兵役、徭役、租調三管齊下維持對北方的準備，民間早已不堪承受；大業六年隋廷正在籌備第一次征高句麗，兵員與糧秣大規模向涿郡、萊州一線集中，北方的州縣守備因此被抽空。第二層是邊郡的社會結構：雁門郡地處長城沿線，統縣五而戶四萬餘，縣境內有關官與長城，邊地戶口流動性大，逃籍、亡命與流民聚居在關隘與山谷一帶，一旦遇上饑年或徵役，最容易成群；張須陀傳記同年濟北王薄「聚結亡命數萬人」，用的正是「亡命」這個詞，說明北方邊地與山東、濟北一帶的流亡人口已經成群結隊，尉文通的三千人只是其中一小股。第三層是地方武力的空隙：州縣雖有郡兵，卻久不操練，邊郡的實際防衛更多依靠關隘、烽燧與城障，一支敢於據谷的武裝足以令郡府一籌莫展。第四層是起事本身的技術門檻極低：亡命之眾以農具改造成兵器、依山守谷、斷絕官軍糧道，一夜之間就能成軍；不需要旗號、口號或編制，尉文通這樣的地方首領卻可以立刻變成「賊帥」。至於尉文通本人為什麼起事，史料沒有留下任何解釋，只留下他聚眾這個事實本身。
causeEn: To understand why this rising appeared in Yanmen, the whole shape of the sixth year of Daye has to be spread out. The first layer is the condition of the state. The late years of Wendi's reign had already made use of service to an extreme degree, the Sui holding the north together with levies, corvees and taxes all at once, and the countryside could bear no more; and in the sixth year of Daye the court was preparing the first campaign against Goguryeo, with men and grain drawn in bulk towards Zhuojun and the Laizhou line, which hollowed out the defence of the northern prefectures. The second layer is the social structure of a frontier commandery. Yanmen lay along the Great Wall, with five counties and forty-two thousand households, a border pass and the Wall itself inside the county, and its population was mobile: men who had fled the register, fugitives and vagrants clustered around the passes and in the valleys, and in a year of failure or of conscription they would clump together readily. The biography of Zhang Xutuo records that in the same year Wang Bo 'gathered tens of thousands of fugitives' in the north of Jibei, and the word used is 'fugitives', which shows that among the borderlands of the north and in Shandong and Jibei the runaways had already gathered in bands, of which the three thousand of Wei Wentong were only a small part. The third layer is the gap in local military strength. The prefectures and counties did have militia, but they had long gone untrained, and the actual defence of a frontier district rested more on the passes, the beacon towers and the wall forts, so that a band ready to hold a valley could put a prefectural government entirely at a loss. The fourth layer is how low the threshold of a rising had fallen. A band of fugitives turned agricultural tools into weapons, held the mountains, cut the supply of the government troops, and could be an army within a night; it needed no banner, no slogan and no establishment, and a local leader such as Wei Wentong could become a 'bandit chief' on the spot. As for why Wei Wentong himself rose, the sources leave no explanation at all; they give only the fact that he gathered a crowd.
impact: 以規模論，這場起義極小——三千人，一個月即平；但把它放回大業六年的北方，就會看見它真正的位置。第一，它是隋末亂局最早的一批火光之一，而且爆在隋朝的北疆：同年濟北有王薄聚亡命數萬，張須陀整整打了一年，從岱山打到臨邑，再打章丘、北海、蹲狗山；大業七年餘杭劉元進舉兵眾至數萬；大業九年更是有陳瑱等眾三萬攻陷信安郡。尉文通的三千人雖然短命，卻說明一件事：起事不再是關東、江南的專利，連雁門關外這種邊郡都一樣可以成軍，而隋廷在北部邊線上真正能倚賴的，只有郡兵和地方官。第二，它暴露了隋朝平叛機制的樣本：朝廷派鷹揚一級的將領率郡兵入谷，一擊而散；同一時期卻要靠張須陀這樣的名將去對付王薄，而且那已經是「官軍擊之，多不利」的狀況——兩個層級的叛亂，官府應付能力相差十倍，說明問題出在基層軍事力量。第三，張須陀的結局在這裡已經埋下伏筆：他是隋末最能打的方面將領之一，卻在大業十二年與翟讓、李密戰於滎陽，躍馬救部眾而潰圍，最終下馬戰死，年五十二；朝廷失去他，正是隋朝崩潰加速的關鍵一步。第四，就史料而言，這場起義的全部文字依據只有帝紀四十餘字；它的價值在於以最短的篇幅留下雁門邊郡在大業年間的實際狀態，也提醒讀者，隋末的史料密度極不平均，多數起義只有一句話，甚至連首領的下落都沒有交代。
impactEn: In scale this rising was very small, three thousand men and a single month before it was settled; but set back into the north of the sixth year of Daye, its real position becomes visible. First, it is one of the earliest flashes of the disorder that would end the Sui, and it broke in the northern frontier: in the same year Wang Bo gathered tens of thousands of fugitives in the north of Jibei, and Zhang Xutuo fought him for a full year, from the Dai hills to Linyi and then on to Zhangqiu, to Beihai and to the crouching-dog hill; in the seventh year of Daye Liu Yuanjin rose at Yuhang with tens of thousands; and in the ninth year there were the three thousand of Chen Zhen who took the prefecture of Xinan. The three thousand of Wei Wentong were short-lived, but they made one thing plain: a rising was no longer a privilege of the east and the south, and could be raised even in a frontier commandery beyond the Yanmen pass, while the only thing the Sui could really rely on in the northern border was the county militia and the local officials. Second, it exposed the sample of the Sui machinery for putting down risings: the court sent an officer of the rank of eagle-raiser with the local militia into the valley and scattered them in a single stroke; at the same time, against Wang Bo it had to fall back on a commander like Zhang Xutuo, and that was already a situation in which 'the government troops attacked and mostly did not prevail', a tenfold difference in the court's capacity between two grades of revolt, which shows that the fault lay in the military strength at the base. Third, the end of Zhang Xutuo was already foreshadowed here. He was among the most capable field commanders of the late Sui, and at the twelfth year of Daye he fought the翟 and Li Mi at Xingyang, leaping on horseback to save his men and breaking out of the encirclement, and at last dismounted and was killed in battle at the age of fifty-two; the court's loss of him was a decisive step in the speeding-up of the collapse. Fourth, as regards the sources, the entire written basis for this rising is a few dozen characters of annal; its value is that it leaves in the briefest possible form the actual state of a frontier commandery in the years of Daye, and it reminds the reader how uneven the density of the late Sui records is, since most risings amount to a single sentence and the fate of even their leaders is not recorded.
result: 大業六年六月壬午，雁門賊帥尉文通聚眾三千、保於莫壁谷，朝廷遣鷹揚將軍楊伯泉擊破之，叛眾潰散，這場起義從起事到平定不足一月。史書只寫「擊破之」三字，沒有說尉文通本人是否被擒、是否被殺，也沒有交代這三千人的去向，因此可以確定的只有一件事：這支部眾被驅散了，首領的生死在文獻中永久空白。對隋廷而言，這是一次乾淨利落的平叛，說明大業六年時中央在北方仍能把一支郡兵部隊派到雁門關外的山地，邊郡的秩序還沒有全面瓦解。但同年同一片北方，另一場起義卻遠沒有這麼好收場：王薄聚結亡命數萬，官軍擊之多不利，張須陀從岱山打到臨邑，又掃章丘、北海、蹲狗山，一年之後才把山東的局面勉強壓住，而左孝友眾十萬、盧明月眾十餘萬、翟讓與李密部接踵而起。到大業九年，陳瑱等眾三萬攻陷信安郡，尉文通當年那三千人的影子已經出現在更大的場合。尉文通起義的結果因此是一個標準的樣板：兵被平掉，亂源未除；名字被記下，故事沒有下文。而它留下的那四十餘字，後來成了大業年間北方邊郡最直接的一份現場記錄。
resultEn: In the sixth year of Daye, in the sixth month, on the day ren-wu, the bandit chief of Yanmen, Wei Wentong, gathered three thousand men and entrenched himself in the valley of Mobi; the court sent Yang Boquan of the rank of eagle-raiser general, and he broke them, the rebel host scattering. From the rising to its suppression took less than a month. The histories write only the three words 'and broke him', and they do not say whether Wei Wentong was taken, whether he was killed, or where the three thousand went; so only one thing is certain, that the band was dispersed and that the fate of its leader is permanently blank in the record. For the court this was a clean suppression, and it shows that in the sixth year of Daye the centre could still send a column of county militia into the mountains beyond the Yanmen pass, and that the order of the frontier districts had not yet broken down. But in the same northern theatre that same year, another rising was by no means so easily closed. Wang Bo had gathered tens of thousands of fugitives, the government troops attacked and mostly did not prevail, and Zhang Xutuo had to fight from the Dai hills to Linyi and then sweep up Zhangqiu, Beihai and the crouching-dog hill before the situation in Shandong could be held down at all; and the ten thousand of Zuo Xiaoyou, the hundred thousand of Lu Mingyue, and the bands of Zhai Rang and Li Mi followed one after another. By the ninth year of Daye the three thousand of Chen Zhen had taken the prefecture of Xinan, and the shadow of Wei Wentong's three thousand had already appeared on a much larger stage. The result of the rising of Wei Wentong is therefore a standard model: the soldiers were put down, the source of the disorder was not; the name was written down, the story has no conclusion. And the forty-odd characters it left behind later became the most direct piece of on-the-spot record of a northern frontier commandery in the years of Daye.
